properties.name: HAN2a
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: This site forms part of a larger site allocation which has been promoted for mixed development for residential and buisness use. This former Peugeot Dealership now has planning permission (164632FUL) for 43 residential units. This permission has not yet been implemented.. Redevelopment of the site to provide a six storey building with one basement level fronting onto Uxbridge Road comprised of 36x residential units on the upper floors, and associated storage, cycle parking, attenuation tank and services at the basement level (Block A); and the construction of 7x three-storey terraced houses fronting onto Westminster Road (Block B) with associated landscaping and substation (Ref. 164632FUL).
